stack.name: GHRP-6 + CJC-1295 (no DAC)
stack.positioning: A research pairing combining the original ghrelin-receptor-agonist GH secretagogue with a GHRH analog to stimulate growth hormone release through two complementary receptor pathways.
stack.rationale: Complementary GH-stimulating mechanisms (GHS-R agonist + GHRH analog). Popular pairing anecdotally; not supported by controlled human outcome trials.
caution_notes: Both peptides in this pairing are Growth Hormone Secretagogues/GHRH analogs (WADA S2), prohibited at all times whether used alone or combined.
GHRP-6 causes pronounced appetite stimulation and modest cortisol/prolactin elevation; combined-use safety data with CJC-1295 (no DAC) has not been formally studied.
stack.disclaimer: For research and educational purposes only. This is not medical advice. Neither peptide is FDA-approved. Consult a licensed healthcare provider before using any peptide.

components.role: Ghrelin-receptor (GHS-R1a) agonist that also stimulates appetite; the original growth hormone-releasing hexapeptide.
GHRH analog that extends the amplitude/duration of GH pulses; commonly paired with a GHRP for a synergistic release pattern.
